Question: Assalamualikum, i am salery employed.my annual salery 4laks indian rupees. i am the only person who ern.i am taking care of my mother,brother,and sister.please tell me.zakat will be wazib on full salery or on the saving after deduction the all expendeture of one year.i will be highly obliged to you. jazakallah. Answer ID: 26347 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1796/1426/B=1431) Pay in Zakah the 2.5% part of the amount that remains in the end of the year after the expenditure of the whole year. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
